I’m using wBlock for macOS, which in turn makes use of the _AdGuard URL Tracking Protection Filter_. It would seem that if you have the AdGuard URL Tracking Protection Filter enabled and if then you try to log in at maccosmetics.com, Safari ends up in a redirect loop, and you get a “Too many redirects” error. **Steps to reproduce the behavior:** 1. First, enable the AdGuard URL Tracking Protection Filter in your ad blocker of choice. 2. Then open https://www.maccosmetics.com/ in Safari on macOS. 3. And then click on the avatar icon in the top right on the page to try to load the MAC Cosmetics login screen. * Expected behavior MAC Cosmetics’ login page loads. * Actual behavior: Safari ends up in a redirect loop, and you get a “Too many redirects” error. 2. Screenshots I like buying makeup from MAC Cosmetics, so when I first came across this issue, I individually disabled the filters in app one by one until I found the one that was causing the issue (which in this case turned out to be the _AdGuard URL Tracking Protection Filter_). And I was able to confirm that once I disabled that filter, I could load the login page at maccosmetics.com. ### Privacy - [x] I agree to follow this condition

issue.body:
luhxe.shop is a counterfeit storefront impersonating the brand Luhxe (registered US trademark LUHXE, Reg. No. 7,656,203; official site https://luhxe.com). It uses the LUHXE mark in the domain and sells fake "Luhxe" bags, taking payment for goods that are not Luhxe's (trademark counterfeiting + non-delivery fraud). Please add https://luhxe.shop to the scam/phishing blocklist so browsers warn users.

Legitimate brand: https://luhxe.com
Counterfeit: https://luhxe.shop

issue.body:
### Prerequisites

- [x] I checked the documentation and found no answer;
- [x] I checked to make sure that this issue has not already been filed;
- [x] This is not an ad/bug report.

### Problem description

There are multiple duplicate rules in the filters.

`#%#//scriptlet('prevent-window-open')`

```
[$domain=/^vidhub\d+\.(cc\|top)$/]##.player-info div[class]:has(> div[class][style] > img[onclick^="window.open"]:first-child + span[style]:last-child)
vidhub2.top,vidhub3.top,vidhub4.cc,vidhub.me,vidhub.tv##.player-info div[class]:has(> div[class][style] > img[onclick^="window.open"]:first-child + span[style]:last-child) 
```

```
8727ck.cc,8726ck.cc##.stui-vodlist > li:has(> div.stui-vodlist__box > a[href][target="_blank"])
[$domain=/87\d{2}ck\.cc/]##.stui-vodlist > li:has(> div.stui-vodlist__box > a[href][target="_blank"])
```

```
||bz*.net/js/cdn.js
||bz88888.net/js/cdn.js
```



### Proposed solution

Merge or remove rules if possible.

### Additional information

_No response_

comment.body:
I'll apply your suggestion, except follow these rules

```adblock
8727ck.cc,8726ck.cc##.stui-vodlist > li:has(> div.stui-vodlist__box > a[href][target="_blank"])
[$domain=/87\d{2}ck\.cc/]##.stui-vodlist > li:has(> div.stui-vodlist__box > a[href][target="_blank"])
```

Some platforms don't support regex in the domain part of cosmetic rules—such as the unpaid iOS version, AdGuard Mini, and the Android Content Blocker app, as well as uBO.

Good example: https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/1eef27783309bc8101ac66a211d5eba4517c617b/TurkishFilter/sections/specific.txt#L4589-L4601

comment.body:
This rule works fine on my iOS device, and the popup with the `X` (close) button closes successfully.
The one from the report (https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/242247#issuecomment-5860738648) does not have a close button. As I recall, it wasn't removed intentionally because the content doesn't load anyway, so it would look like a broken website.

From what I remember, scriptlets are injected differently than JS rules and should work in this case.
The problem only affects JS rules, but that is probably a question for the Safari extension developers.

```adblock
kick.com#%#//scriptlet('prevent-setTimeout', '_sendBeaconQueue')
```

# Comment
On this site's anti-adblock detection is triggered when the **Japanese filter (full version)** is enabled. The **optimized version of the same filter does not reproduce the issue**.

 - Full: https://filters.adtidy.org/ios/filters/7.txt
 - Optimized: https://filters.adtidy.org/ios/filters/7_optimized.txt

 ## Reproduction Results
 
 | Filters enabled | Result |
 |---|---|
 | Japanese (full) only | Normal (OK) |
 | Japanese (optimized) only | Normal (OK) |
 | Base + Japanese (full) | Anti-adblock **IS shown** (NG) |
 | Base + Japanese (optimized) | Normal (OK) |
 | Base only | Normal (OK) |

# Comment
On this site's anti-adblock detection is triggered when the **Japanese filter (full version)** is enabled. The **optimized version of the same filter does not reproduce the issue**.

 - Full: https://filters.adtidy.org/ios/filters/7.txt
 - Optimized: https://filters.adtidy.org/ios/filters/7_optimized.txt

 ## Reproduction Results
 
 | Filters enabled | Result |
 |---|---|
 | Japanese (full) only | Normal (OK) |
 | Japanese (optimized) only | Normal (OK) |
 | Base + Japanese (full) | Anti-adblock **IS shown** (NG) |
 | Base + Japanese (optimized) | Normal (OK) |
 | Base only | Normal (OK) |
 

 ## Note on the optimized filter as a workaround
 
 Switching to the optimized filter is not a viable workaround here. I browse a wide range of sites as part of my work, and the optimized list drops rules that the full list needs to cover them. Falling back to the optimized list and then reporting each missed site individually would defeat the purpose of the optimization, so I would like the full list itself to be fixed.
 
 ## Steps Already Tried (none resolved the issue)
 
 - Updated the filter rules to the latest version
 - Updated the AdGuard iOS app to the latest version
 - Restarted the device
 - Cleared Safari's cache
 - Disabled all content blockers in Safari settings and enabled them again
 - Restarted Safari
 - Restarted AdGuard
 - Checked for filter updates in AdGuard (wait 1 min)
 
 ## Additional Information
 
 - The only Safari extension enabled is AdGuard, so interference from other extensions can be ruled out.
 - Switching between the full and optimized lists was done with a full filter update in between.
 - I believe this is the same as or similar to issue #241409.
 
 

## Screenshots

![](https://i.postimg.cc/bvCfNtdc/image.png)

</details>

# ATTENTION

> [!NOTE]  
> YouTube changes their detection scripts regularly. That means that sometime you can face the detection message.
> If all the following instructions do not work, please **email filters@adguard.com** or wait until any update is available. 

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use another adblocker in the same time because using another adblocker can delay/lags the YouTube loading (e.g., AdBlock Plus and AdBlock)[^1] OR interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use an userscript related to the bypassing YouTube detection message like [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing).
> Recently, YouTube anti-adblock script added infinite dummy advertisements to try to neutralize the userscript. ( [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing#264](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing/issues/264) )

> [!WARNING]
> Please check that there no another web browser extension that has adblocking feature is enabled on your web browser. It can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> Saving memory feature of your web browser or sleep feature of your operating system can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.
> In this case, please re-enable AdGuard's filtering by toggling the protection toggle.
> Following the instructions can be needed.

### The instructions
1. Force to update the filters by clicking the reload button in AdGuard Browser Extension/AdGuard mobile or update tray menu in your system tray. [^2]
2. Reload the YouTube webpage without cache by pressing <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd> [^3].
3. Clear cache, cookies and site data of your web browser.
4. Re-open your web browser completely (checking your system monitor[^4] will be better).

[^1]: https://gitlab.com/adblockinc/ext/adblockplus/adblockplusui/-/issues/1576
[^2]: [AdGuard for Windows](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-windows/overview/#tray-menu); [AdGuard for Mac](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-mac/overview/#updates-check); 
[^3]: On macOS, <kbd>Command</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd>
[^4]: Task Manager on Windows, System Monitor on GNOME Shell, KDE System Guard on KDE Plasma or Activity Monitor on macOS.

comment.body:
> Adguard (specifically the Protection Ad Blocking option) blocks the Google search engine's AI Overview response. This is consistent across Chrome, Firefox and Edge browsers and is consistent with and without extensions enabled. The results are the same for all Google searches that have an AI Overview in the response. It is also the case using incognito mode or normal mode.
> It seems to only be a problem when Adguard Protection 'Ad blocking' is enabled and is not a problem when the 'Ad blocking' Protection setting is disabled.

We block it only in AdGuard Other Annoyances filter.

issue.body:
# ATTENTION

> [!NOTE]  
> YouTube changes their detection scripts regularly. That means that sometime you can face the detection message.
> If all the following instructions do not work, please **email filters@adguard.com** or wait until any update is available. 

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use another adblocker in the same time because using another adblocker can delay/lags the YouTube loading (e.g., AdBlock Plus and AdBlock)[^1] OR interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use an userscript related to the bypassing YouTube detection message like [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing).
> Recently, YouTube anti-adblock script added infinite dummy advertisements to try to neutralize the userscript. ( [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing#264](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing/issues/264) )

> [!WARNING]
> Please check that there no another web browser extension that has adblocking feature is enabled on your web browser. It can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> Saving memory feature of your web browser or sleep feature of your operating system can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.
> In this case, please re-enable AdGuard's filtering by toggling the protection toggle.
> Following the instructions can be needed.

### The instructions
1. Force to update the filters by clicking the reload button in AdGuard Browser Extension/AdGuard mobile or update tray menu in your system tray. [^2]
2. Reload the YouTube webpage without cache by pressing <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd> [^3].
3. Clear cache, cookies and site data of your web browser.
4. Re-open your web browser completely (checking your system monitor[^4] will be better).

[^1]: https://gitlab.com/adblockinc/ext/adblockplus/adblockplusui/-/issues/1576
[^2]: [AdGuard for Windows](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-windows/overview/#tray-menu); [AdGuard for Mac](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-mac/overview/#updates-check); 
[^3]: On macOS, <kbd>Command</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd>
[^4]: Task Manager on Windows, System Monitor on GNOME Shell, KDE System Guard on KDE Plasma or Activity Monitor on macOS. 


Previous issue https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/198973

issue.body:
# ATTENTION

> [!NOTE]  
> YouTube changes their detection scripts regularly. That means that sometime you can face the detection message.
> If all the following instructions do not work, please **email filters@adguard.com** or wait until any update is available. 

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use another adblocker in the same time because using another adblocker can delay/lags the YouTube loading (e.g., AdBlock Plus and AdBlock)[^1] OR interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use an userscript related to the bypassing YouTube detection message like [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing).
> Recently, YouTube anti-adblock script added infinite dummy advertisements to try to neutralize the userscript. ( [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing#264](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing/issues/264) )

> [!WARNING]
> Please check that there no another web browser extension that has adblocking feature is enabled on your web browser. It can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> Saving memory feature of your web browser or sleep feature of your operating system can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.
> In this case, please re-enable AdGuard's filtering by toggling the protection toggle.
> Following the instructions can be needed.

### The instructions
1. Force to update the filters by clicking the reload button in AdGuard Browser Extension/AdGuard mobile or update tray menu in your system tray. [^2]
2. Reload the YouTube webpage without cache by pressing <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd> [^3].
3. Clear cache, cookies and site data of your web browser.
4. Re-open your web browser completely (checking your system monitor[^4] will be better).

[^1]: https://gitlab.com/adblockinc/ext/adblockplus/adblockplusui/-/issues/1576
[^2]: [AdGuard for Windows](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-windows/overview/#tray-menu); [AdGuard for Mac](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-mac/overview/#updates-check); 
[^3]: On macOS, <kbd>Command</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd>
[^4]: Task Manager on Windows, System Monitor on GNOME Shell, KDE System Guard on KDE Plasma or Activity Monitor on macOS.

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use an userscript related to the bypassing YouTube detection message like [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing).
> Recently, YouTube anti-adblock script added infinite dummy advertisements to try to neutralize the userscript. ( [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing#264](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing/issues/264) )

> [!WARNING]
> Please check that there no another web browser extension that has adblocking feature is enabled on your web browser. It can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> Saving memory feature of your web browser or sleep feature of your operating system can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.
> In this case, please re-enable AdGuard's filtering by toggling the protection toggle.
> Following the instructions can be needed.

### The instructions
1. Force to update the filters by clicking the reload button in AdGuard Browser Extension/AdGuard mobile or update tray menu in your system tray. [^2]
2. Reload the YouTube webpage without cache by pressing <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd> [^3].
3. Clear cache, cookies and site data of your web browser.
4. Re-open your web browser completely (checking your system monitor[^4] will be better).

[^1]: https://gitlab.com/adblockinc/ext/adblockplus/adblockplusui/-/issues/1576
[^2]: [AdGuard for Windows](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-windows/overview/#tray-menu); [AdGuard for Mac](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-mac/overview/#updates-check); 
[^3]: On macOS, <kbd>Command</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd>
[^4]: Task Manager on Windows, System Monitor on GNOME Shell, KDE System Guard on KDE Plasma or Activity Monitor on macOS.

# Sorry. The website is infected by AdShield, Inc.

Unfortunately, It is complicated to resolve with a regular adblock rule because the website is being protected by service of Ad-Shield that is an anti-adblock company.

## Userscript Installation
Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).
Please check its installation guideline written in English by visiting [this URL](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.md).

If you can understand Korean language, please refer https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.ko.md.

New change of tinyShield's build script for Apple Safari Extension user (made at 2026 Apr 21) is available.

## Still Have a Problem?
An issue is occurred when the userscript is applied, please report to [this issue tracker](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/issues).

issue.body:
# ATTENTION

> [!NOTE]  
> YouTube changes their detection scripts regularly. That means that sometime you can face the detection message.
> If all the following instructions do not work, please **email filters@adguard.com** or wait until any update is available. 

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use another adblocker in the same time because using another adblocker can delay/lags the YouTube loading (e.g., AdBlock Plus and AdBlock)[^1] OR interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use an userscript related to the bypassing YouTube detection message like [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing).
> Recently, YouTube anti-adblock script added infinite dummy advertisements to try to neutralize the userscript. ( [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing#264](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing/issues/264) )

> [!WARNING]
> Please check that there no another web browser extension that has adblocking feature is enabled on your web browser. It can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> Saving memory feature of your web browser or sleep feature of your operating system can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.
> In this case, please re-enable AdGuard's filtering by toggling the protection toggle.
> Following the instructions can be needed.

### The instructions
1. Force to update the filters by clicking the reload button in AdGuard Browser Extension/AdGuard mobile or update tray menu in your system tray. [^2]
2. Reload the YouTube webpage without cache by pressing <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd> [^3].
3. Clear cache, cookies and site data of your web browser.
4. Re-open your web browser completely (checking your system monitor[^4] will be better).

[^1]: https://gitlab.com/adblockinc/ext/adblockplus/adblockplusui/-/issues/1576
[^2]: [AdGuard for Windows](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-windows/overview/#tray-menu); [AdGuard for Mac](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-mac/overview/#updates-check); 
[^3]: On macOS, <kbd>Command</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd>
[^4]: Task Manager on Windows, System Monitor on GNOME Shell, KDE System Guard on KDE Plasma or Activity Monitor on macOS. 


Previous issue https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/198973

issue.title: Duplicate rules in ChineseFilter (specific.txt)
issue.body:
### Prerequisites

- [x] I checked the documentation and found no answer;
- [x] I checked to make sure that this issue has not already been filed;
- [x] This is not an ad/bug report.

### Problem description

There are multiple duplicate rules in the filters.

`#%#//scriptlet('prevent-window-open')`

```
[$domain=/^vidhub\d+\.(cc\|top)$/]##.player-info div[class]:has(> div[class][style] > img[onclick^="window.open"]:first-child + span[style]:last-child)
vidhub2.top,vidhub3.top,vidhub4.cc,vidhub.me,vidhub.tv##.player-info div[class]:has(> div[class][style] > img[onclick^="window.open"]:first-child + span[style]:last-child) 
```

```
8727ck.cc,8726ck.cc##.stui-vodlist > li:has(> div.stui-vodlist__box > a[href][target="_blank"])
[$domain=/87\d{2}ck\.cc/]##.stui-vodlist > li:has(> div.stui-vodlist__box > a[href][target="_blank"])
```

```
||bz*.net/js/cdn.js
||bz88888.net/js/cdn.js
```



### Proposed solution

Merge or remove rules if possible.

### Additional information

_No response_
